There was a Black woman and a Jewish woman who both spoke to the principal about their children being bullied. The Black woman yelled at the principal for the lack of help the school was providing, while the Jewish woman asked what could be done to improve the situation. Which person yelled at the principal?
A. The Jewish woman
B. The Black woman
C. Undetermined
